universities.name: Easwari Engineering College
universities.summary: Easwari Engineering College is a private autonomous engineering college in Ramapuram, Chennai, affiliated to Anna University. Its undergraduate portfolio spans computing, electrical and mechanical disciplines alongside biotechnology, biomedical engineering, civil engineering and robotics. Government-quota engineering admission follows the TNEA route.
universities.campusLifestyle: Student clubs and support for innovation and start-ups form part of campus life at Ramapuram. The college also offers a semester-abroad programme; access, destinations and selection arrangements are separate from admission to the degree.
universities.cityProfile: The campus is on Bharathi Salai, Ramapuram, Chennai 600089, with Guindy identified as the nearest railway station in the current government directory. Students can compare hostel residence with daily travel using the college transport service. Route, accommodation and meal choices require a cost plan separate from tuition.
universities.practicalExposure: The B.Tech. Computer Science and Business System programme is offered with a TCS partnership. Institution-level support also includes innovation and start-up activity and a semester-abroad programme. These opportunities have different scopes: the named TCS partnership belongs to CSBS and does not establish a placement, overseas-study or industry-training entitlement for every degree.
universities.hostelOverview: Separate permanent hostels are available for undergraduate men and women. The government 2026 directory separates annual room and electricity charges, with different room charges for the two hostels. Obtain the current currency-labelled category-specific schedule before budgeting; mess, deposits and tuition must not be merged into an unexplained total.
universities.dietarySupport: Both vegetarian and non-vegetarian mess options are recorded for the undergraduate hostels. The government directory states mess charges separately on an annual basis, rather than including them in the room tariff. Confirm the applicable meal arrangement and current payable amount directly before accepting accommodation.
universities.safetyOverview: The college provides a dedicated anti-ragging contact, 9600396937. Use this channel for ragging-related concerns; it is not a general emergency-response guarantee.
universities.studentSupport: Admissions assistance covers choosing between courses and navigating the application process. Students Traffic can help assess the applicable TNEA route, organise the document checklist and build a shortlist before applying.

restrictions: This listing covers only first-year academic-stream government-quota TNEA seats at Easwari Engineering College, not an independently verified foreign/NRI quota, management, vocational or lateral-entry route.
Indian applicants must satisfy one of the six TNEA nativity, Tamil Nadu schooling or parent-service categories detailed below; an Indian passport alone is insufficient.

Tamil Nadu candidates who passed Classes VIII–XII in Tamil Nadu may apply without a nativity certificate. Tamil Nadu natives who studied any of those classes outside the state require a digitally signed nativity certificate.

Children of Central Government employees qualify irrespective of nativity if a parent—or guardian only where both parents are deceased—served continuously in Tamil Nadu for five years; employer evidence is required.

Children of permanent public-sector or government-recognised-institution employees qualify irrespective of domicile with five continuous years of Tamil Nadu employment and the specified employer/supporting records.
Children of All India Service Tamil Nadu-cadre officers require a parental declaration. Other-state candidates who studied Classes VIII–XII in Tamil Nadu may apply without a nativity certificate.
The parent-service and other-state schooling categories are considered under Open Competition; communal reservation requires Tamil Nadu nativity and the prescribed state community certificate.
Tamil Nadu-native OCI/PIO cardholders may participate under Open Category, except those born in a foreign country after 4 March 2021. Do not broaden this to every OCI/PIO or foreign applicant.

Sri Lankan Tamil refugees who studied in Tamil Nadu may participate under Open Competition with Headquarters Tahsildar identification; those outside refugee-camp registration also need original passport, visa and police-registration letter.

admissionsContent.overview: B.E. Automobile Engineering is a four-year degree at Ramapuram, Chennai. For the TNEA academic-stream government-quota route, use college code 1304 and branch code AU. Admission depends on eligibility, verification, rank and allotment.

eligibility.intro: The academic-stream route requires higher-secondary mathematics, physics and chemistry and eligibility under a permitted TNEA category. OCI/PIO and refugee provisions have additional restrictions.
items: Pass HSC academic first and second years (+1 and +2), or an accepted equivalent, with mathematics, physics and chemistry.
Minimum Class 12 PCM average: 45% for general-category applicants; 40% for eligible Tamil Nadu BC/BCM, MBC/DNC, SC/SCA/ST applicants.
Indian applicants must satisfy TNEA nativity, Tamil Nadu schooling or the specified parental-employment/service exceptions.
OCI/PIO cardholders must be Tamil Nadu natives; those born in a foreign country after 4 March 2021 are excluded from this provision.
Sri Lankan Tamil refugees must have studied in Tamil Nadu and provide the required refugee identification records.
The OCI/PIO and Sri Lankan Tamil refugee provisions are open-category/open-competition routes, not communal-reservation entitlements.
Eligibility must be met by the application closing date; later qualification results do not establish eligibility for that cycle.

faq.question: Is Easwari a private college or an SRM university campus?
faq.answer: Easwari Engineering College is a private autonomous college affiliated to Anna University at Ramapuram, Chennai. Its TNEA college code is 1304; this profile is not a listing for SRM Institute of Science and Technology.

faq.question: Which undergraduate engineering areas are offered?
faq.answer: The college offers conventional engineering and computing degrees alongside automobile engineering, biomedical engineering, biotechnology and robotics. Computing choices include CSE, AI and Machine Learning, Cyber Security, Computer Science and Design, and Computer Science and Business System.

faq.question: How long is a first-year B.E. or B.Tech. degree?
faq.answer: The standard first-year B.E./B.Tech. route lasts four academic years, comprising eight semesters. Lateral-entry and postgraduate routes are separate and are not described by this first-year duration.

faq.question: What Class 12 subjects and marks are required?
faq.answer: For the TNEA academic-stream route, pass both HSC years or an accepted equivalent. The Class 12 average in mathematics, physics and chemistry must be at least 45% for the general category or 40% for the specified eligible reserved categories; nativity and category rules also apply.

faq.question: Can applicants from outside Tamil Nadu use TNEA?
faq.answer: Other-state applicants who studied Classes VIII–XII in Tamil Nadu can apply under the specified rule. Other permitted cases include qualifying parental employment or service exceptions. These conditions are narrower than an unrestricted all-India admission route.

faq.question: Can OCI, PIO or refugee applicants apply?
faq.answer: TNEA permits Tamil Nadu-native OCI/PIO cardholders under its open-category provision, excluding those born abroad after 4 March 2021. Sri Lankan Tamil refugees who studied in Tamil Nadu have a separate open-competition provision with identification requirements. These are not general foreign-national admission offers.

faq.question: How does the TNEA application process work?
faq.answer: Register online, provide academic and category details, upload certificate copies and complete verification. During counselling use college code 1304 and the relevant branch code, then follow the allotted round’s choice-filling, confirmation and reporting steps. Eligibility does not guarantee allotment.

faq.question: Which documents should I prepare?
faq.answer: Prepare Class 10, HSC first-year and second-year or equivalent marksheets and the transfer certificate. Nativity, community, income, first-graduate, government-school, refugee and special-reservation records are required only where the applicable route or claim calls for them.

faq.question: What does hostel accommodation cost?
faq.answer: Separate permanent undergraduate hostels are listed for men and women. Room, electricity and mess charges are separate, and the government 2026 table labels these components per annum. Obtain a currency-labelled current schedule and confirm deposits and other charges; no all-inclusive tuition-and-hostel total is inferred.

faq.question: Are vegetarian meals and college transport available?
faq.answer: Both vegetarian and non-vegetarian mess options are available in the undergraduate hostels. College transport is also listed. Meal, room and transport choices have separate charges; request the applicable current schedule rather than assuming one uniform residence cost.

faq.question: What industry or overseas-study opportunities are identified?
faq.answer: The Computer Science and Business System degree has a TCS partnership. The college also offers innovation and start-up support and a semester-abroad programme. Participation conditions are separate, and these opportunities do not guarantee employment or a place abroad.

faq.question: Is tuition included in the living-cost figures?
faq.answer: No. Room, electricity, mess and transport figures describe separate living-cost components. Tuition is on request for the applicant’s admission category; Students Traffic can help organise a programme-specific fee and full-cost plan before payment.
